title: DSD review decisions
description: One reviewer's decisions on one queue. Each decision names the exact content hash it was made against; if the text changed after the queue was generated the decision is stale and is refused. A decision approves or rejects — it cannot publish, and it cannot carry replacement wording, because rewriting is authoring and an author cannot review their own work. This schema documents the contract; scripts/dsd/review.ts is the enforcing implementation and additionally checks the reviewer against data/dsd/contributor-registry.json, refuses self-review, and refuses transitions that skip a state.

queue_id.description: The queue this reviewer worked from, as written by dsd:review:queue.

reviewer_id.description: Pseudonymous contributor ID holding 'reviewer' or 'linguistic_reviewer'. Must not be the author of any record decided here.

decision_evidence_id.description: Identifies the signed review record. Required because dsd_provenance_events stores no free text: the notes below live in this committed file, and the ledger event points at it.

entity_kind.description: Translations and examples are decided independently of their sense: an accurate definition with a weak example is a rejected example, not a rejected sense.

content_sha256.description: The hash shown in the queue. A decision that does not match the row's current hash is stale and is refused rather than applied.

notes.description: DSD-specific guidance the author can act on. Required for a rejection. Must not link out or name a blocked source — a reviewer who directs an author towards third-party wording ends the clean-room chain.

$comment: Forbidden fields, rejected by name: definition_en, translation_vi, text, example_en, example_vi, replacement, rewrite, suggested_text, status, reviewed_at, published_at, content_hash_override, word_id, definition_id, source_definition_id, legacy_id, oewn_sense_id, provider, model, prompt, api_key, similarity_score. reviewed_at is set by the database so a file cannot backdate a review; publication is dsd:publish, which runs the completeness, provenance, quality and similarity gates first and treats a gate that has not run as a block.
